name: plugin.agent_reach_bridge
description: Agent Reach bridge integrating multi-platform web extraction, stealth CloakBrowser CDP sessions, and Schema v1 result envelopes
author: Agent Reach Bridge Forge

entrypoints.name: reach_read
entrypoints.description: Read content from target URL via automatic channel matching and fallback cascades

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Target webpage or platform URL to read

entrypoints.name: reach_action
entrypoints.description: Execute a platform-specific action (e.g. search, comments, user info)

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Target platform channel (e.g. youtube, github, reddit, web)

entrypoints.name: reach_inspect_channels
entrypoints.description: List all supported platform channels, support tiers, and declared actions

entrypoints.name: reach_scrub_url
entrypoints.description: Sanitize and redact basic authentication credentials from URL or text

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: URL or text string to scrub
